title: Turquoise3D Standalone Items
description: Items from both Turquoise3D and T3D Extra, in a single pack, nothing else included.
body: Items from both Turquoise3D and T3D Extra, in a single pack, nothing else included. Just you, the items and anything else from vanilla or your other resource packs. Reminds me when I had 35 resource packs active at once, haha.
